question: Which of the following energy resources is also known as Liquid Gold?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Petroleum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Petroleum

 
 
• Petroleum is commonly known as **Liquid gold.**
 
• Due to the fact that crude oil turns black when it is removed from the ground, petroleum is also known as "black gold."
 
• Petroleum is a liquid that naturally exists below the surface of the planet.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Natural Gas:**

 
 
• In terms of **environmental impact** and **air pollution**, **natural gas** is generally considered **cleaner** compared to **diesel, petroleum**, and **coal**.
 
• **Natural gas** emits **fewer pollutants**, including sulfur dioxide (**SO2**), nitrogen oxides (**NOx**), **particulate matter**, and **greenhouse gases** such as carbon dioxide (**CO2**), compared to the other options listed. 
 
 
 
• **Coal:**
 
 
• Coal is a black or brown flammable substance found in sedimentary rocks.
 
• Coal is mainly composed of elements like carbon, hydrogen, sulfur, oxygen, and nitrogen.
 
 
 
• Uranium:
 
 
• ​It is a **silvery-white** metallic chemical element in the periodic table, with atomic number 92. 
 
• It is assigned the chemical **symbol** ‘**U**’.
 
• A uranium atom has **92 protons** and **92 electrons**, of which **6** are valence electrons. 
 
• Uranium has the highest **atomic weight (19 kg m**) of all naturally occurring elements.
